atoms.a: Plants around the house improve the quality of the air in your home. Not only this, but they are also great for decoration.
This is a great skill to learn, and you will use it throughout your life. There are lots of different types of food that you can make. You should always make sure to clean up after yourself though.

atoms.a: These amphibians usually live in ponds. They start their life as tadpoles, which you can often see in ponds or rivers.
These insects are extremely strong for their size. They can carry up to 50 times their body weight on their back. They are also very good at teamwork.
This animal is most commonly found in the jungle. However, in the UK, they can only be found in zoos. They are known to be quite cheeky.

atoms.a:
Computers

This is a tool used to chop your food. You usually use this together with a fork to hold down your food.

Pollen

This can be found on plants and in the air towards the end of spring. Some people are allergic to it and suffer from hay fever.

Swimming

This is the most common water sport. You can do it in pools, in lakes, or in the sea.
